cues: An alcohol with one hydroxyl group is monohydric, general formula C n H two n plus one O H.
Two hydroxyl groups make a dihydric alcohol like glycol, three a trihydric one like glycerol.
The carbon carrying the O H is called the carbinol carbon.
text: An alcohol with one hydroxyl group is monohydric, general formula C n H two n plus one O H. Two hydroxyl groups make a dihydric alcohol like glycol, three a trihydric one like glycerol. The carbon carrying the O H is called the carbinol carbon.
